mapper.sql: a.album_id,a.group_id,a.user_id,a.space_id,a.name,a.description,a.type, a.cover_asset_id, COALESCE(explicit_cover.public_id, first_cover.public_id) AS cover_asset_public_id, a.sort, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM album_media am_count INNER JOIN media_asset a_count ON a_count.asset_id=am_count.asset_id WHERE am_count.album_id=a.album_id AND a_count.media_type='IMAGE' AND a_count.deleted_at IS NULL) AS photo_count, a.created_at,a.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM album_group WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND type='AI' AND name='AI 整理' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO album_group(user_id,space_id,name,type,sort) VALUES(#{userId},(SELECT space_id FROM diary_space WHERE personal_owner_id=#{userId}),#{name},#{type},#{sort})
mapper.update: UPDATE album_group SET name=#{name} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND group_id=#{groupId} AND type='CUSTOM'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM album_group WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND group_id=#{groupId} AND type='CUSTOM'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM album_group WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND group_id=#{groupId}
SELECT * FROM album_group WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY CASE type WHEN 'AI' THEN 10 ELSE 20 END,sort,group_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO album(group_id,user_id,space_id,name,description,type,cover_asset_id,sort) VALUES(#{groupId},#{userId},(SELECT space_id FROM diary_space WHERE personal_owner_id=#{userId}),#{name},#{description},#{type},#{coverAssetId},#{sort})
mapper.update: UPDATE album SET name=#{name},description=#{description},cover_asset_id=#{coverAssetId} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND album_id=#{albumId} AND type IN ('AI','CUSTOM')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM album WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND album_id=#{albumId} AND type IN ('AI','CUSTOM')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM album a LEFT JOIN media_asset explicit_cover ON explicit_cover.asset_id=a.cover_asset_id AND explicit_cover.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN media_asset first_cover ON first_cover.asset_id=(SELECT am.asset_id FROM album_media am INNER JOIN media_asset fa ON fa.asset_id=am.asset_id WHERE am.album_id=a.album_id AND fa.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY am.sort,am.asset_id LIMIT 1) WHERE a.user_id=#{userId} AND a.album_id=#{albumId}

SELECT FROM album a LEFT JOIN media_asset explicit_cover ON explicit_cover.asset_id=a.cover_asset_id AND explicit_cover.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN media_asset first_cover ON first_cover.asset_id=(SELECT am.asset_id FROM album_media am INNER JOIN media_asset fa ON fa.asset_id=am.asset_id WHERE am.album_id=a.album_id AND fa.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY am.sort,am.asset_id LIMIT 1) WHERE a.group_id IN #{groupId} ORDER BY a.sort,a.album_id

SELECT FROM album a LEFT JOIN media_asset explicit_cover ON explicit_cover.asset_id=a.cover_asset_id AND explicit_cover.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN media_asset first_cover ON first_cover.asset_id=(SELECT am.asset_id FROM album_media am INNER JOIN media_asset fa ON fa.asset_id=am.asset_id WHERE am.album_id=a.album_id AND fa.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY am.sort,am.asset_id LIMIT 1) WHERE a.user_id=#{userId} AND a.type='AI' ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC,a.album_id DESC
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort),-1)+1 FROM album_media WHERE album_id=#{albumId}
mapper.delete: DELETE am FROM album_media am INNER JOIN media_asset a ON a.asset_id=am.asset_id WHERE am.album_id=#{albumId} AND a.public_id=#{assetId}
mapper.sql: a_asset.public_id AS asset_public_id, dm.diary_id,d.user_id,am.sort, d.title AS diary_title,d.date AS diary_date,d.mood_key, CASE WHEN fm.asset_id IS NULL THEN false ELSE true END AS favorite, COALESCE(d.created_at,a_asset.created_at) AS created_at

FROM album_media am INNER JOIN album alb ON alb.album_id=am.album_id INNER JOIN media_asset a_asset ON a_asset.asset_id=am.asset_id LEFT JOIN diary_media dm ON dm.asset_id=a_asset.asset_id AND dm.diary_id=(SELECT MIN(dm2.diary_id) FROM diary_media dm2 INNER JOIN diary d2 ON d2.diary_id=dm2.diary_id WHERE dm2.asset_id=a_asset.asset_id AND d2.user_id=alb.user_id AND d2.deleted_at IS NULL AND d2.locked=0) LEFT JOIN diary d ON d.diary_id=dm.diary_id LEFT JOIN favorite_media fm ON fm.asset_id=a_asset.asset_id AND fm.user_id=#{userId} WHERE alb.user_id=#{userId} AND alb.album_id=#{albumId} AND a_asset.media_type='IMAGE' AND a_asset.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY am.sort,a_asset.asset_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
